In the 440 yards both Cope and McKenzie failed to make an appearance and it is a pity that when chaps are sent a card that they do not reply if they cannot turn out.

The race was set up nicely by McKenzie and Whittle, and then Black stormed away from the field with a 43.96 stint to leave Du'aine Ladejo the honour of a lonely last lap of 44.19 for his second 'gold'.
